title: Squares of dimensions add to |D₄| = 8
caption: D₄ has five conjugacy classes, so five irreducible representations, and the squares of their dimensions must add to the order 8. The only way is 1² + 1² + 1² + 1² + 2² = 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 4 = 8: four 1-dimensional and one 2-dimensional.
alt: One bar of 8 units split into five parts: four parts of 1 labelled 1² and one part of 4 labelled 2².
description: Five classes give five irreducible representations.
Each contributes the square of its dimension to the total 8.
Four of dimension 1 give four parts of 1; one of dimension 2 gives a part of 4.

checks.name: the squares of the dimensions 1, 1, 1, 1, 2 are 1, 1, 1, 1, 4, adding to 8
